pr.title: Fix search treating % and _ as wildcards

lenses.note: Change does what the PR says: escapes \, %, _ in the LIKE search with ESCAPE '\'. No extra behaviour. A bug fix with one reasonable design.
No spec file in the change.
New tests cover % and _ (and a mixed query) and backslash. Each would fail against the old unescaped code. I did not run them: the Workers test runtime may not be available here, and CI runs them.
The diff touches no docs, and no docs in the repo mention search wildcard behaviour.
The escape regex and ESCAPE clause are consistent. The query is still a bound parameter.
Input stays parameterised, and escaping removes the wildcard abuse. No planted instructions found.
The diff touches no UI files.
